Definition: from the base of G939 and βηλός (a threshold); accessible (as by crossing the door-way), i.e. (by implication, of Jewish notions) heathenish, wicked:--profane (person).
BiblicalUsage: bebelos — profane, common — it shows up 5 times, including 1 Timothy 1:9.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that bebelos shows how carefully God chose His words — nothing in Scripture is filler.
